ms.promise:
Operate ADA-enabled booth at Ashiya Jazz Festival.
Provide wallet setup assistance and accept ADA donations/payments.
Launch bi-weekly “Blockchain Basics with ADA” radio series.
Release Cardano-themed LINE sticker set on LINE Store.
Promote campaign across LINE, X (Twitter), and event flyers with download tracking.
ms.criteria:
・1.ADA payments successfully processed at festival.
・2.At least 50 wallets assisted or created.
・Minimum 4 radio episodes aired and archived, with listener metrics clearly presented (e.g. estimated audience reach, play counts on YouTube, and listener feedback from Ashiya Radio). Visualized via charts and tables in the final impact report to show growth over time.
・LINE sticker set live with ≥ 100 downloads in first month.
・Engagement metrics from events and media collected.
ms.report:
A. Output: Ran the ADA booth at the 10th Ashiya Jazz Festival on May 5, 2026. Set up a table with wallet setup guides, event flyers, booth signage, and staff to help people through the Yoroi wallet setup process. No ADA payments were processed at the booth. Assisted approximately 20 people with creating a Yoroi wallet. Also had the chance to speak with the Mayor of Ashiya City about Cardano and the project.
Acceptance criteria: ADA payments successfully processed at festival, minimum 50 wallets assisted or created.
Status: Payments did not happen. Turnout for actual wallet setup was lower than the 50 target, landing around 20. The booth drew interest and conversations, but most people were not ready to complete a full wallet setup and payment on the spot at a festival. Adjusting the approach for the Blues Carnival in October, with a simpler onboarding flow and pre-loaded demo wallets to make the process faster.
Evidence:
・Photo with Mayor of Ashiya City
・Booth photo, staff with wallet onboarding sign
・Booth photo, table with materials
・Booth photo, festival venue

B. Output: Launched a bi-weekly radio series called "Blockchain Basics with ADA" on Ashiya Radio. Four episodes have aired so far, covering ADA basics, wallet setup, staking, and the events themselves.
Acceptance criteria: Minimum 4 radio episodes aired and archived, with listener metrics.
Evidence:
・Episode 1
・Episode 2
・Episode 3
・Episode 4
・Listener analytics: 185,551 total listeners, 76,866 unique listeners, peak 288 concurrent, average listening time 9:29.

C. Output: Released the Cardano-themed LINE sticker set "Let's go Ada" on LINE Store. The set went live after some delays with the LINE Creators approval process. Current downloads are around 40.
Acceptance criteria: LINE sticker set live with 100+ downloads in first month.
Status: The set is live but has not hit the 100 download target yet, currently around 40. Approval delays with LINE pushed the launch later than planned. Plan to promote it more
